description: Add one line to a draft change order: added or removed with a quantity and a unit price in minor units, or changed with the old and the new quantity and price, each with a reason and a date. Free.

change_order.description: The change order id, e.g. CO-2026-0001, or its title when only one carries it

date.description: The day the change was asked for, YYYY-MM-DD. Default the change order's date

description.description: The line as it reads on the quote or work order, e.g. Website audit

kind.description: added for new work, removed for work taken out, changed for a line whose quantity or price moves

quantity.description: added or removed: how many. changed: the NEW quantity

reason.description: Why, in the client's words if you have them, e.g. Client asked for a second page after the kickoff

tax_rate.description: VAT percent for this line, overriding the shared profile's default

unit_price_minor.description: added or removed: the unit price in whole minor units. changed: the NEW unit price. 45000 is EUR 450.00

was_quantity.description: changed only: the quantity before the change

was_unit_price_minor.description: changed only: the unit price before the change, in whole minor units

name: change_order_add_line
title: Add a changed line
